name: reset
description: Reset password: choosing a new password from the link, on the login spread. One render for every platform, the same markup on each; a state is the form section's content.

platform.description: The device the page is drawn for. No platform rule: the spread is the same markup on every platform; its sections respond to their container.

noRule.mobile: a page has no CSS: the platform chooses which modules it composes and how
noRule.tablet: a page has no CSS: the platform chooses which modules it composes and how
noRule.desktop: a page has no CSS: the platform chooses which modules it composes and how

noRule.default: a page has no CSS: a state is the form section's content
noRule.short: a page has no CSS: a state is the form section's content
noRule.saving: a page has no CSS: a state is the form section's content
noRule.expired: a page has no CSS: a state is the form section's content
noRule.network: a page has no CSS: a state is the form section's content

context.description: Where the page is drawn. screen: the numbered screens (the static header). walkthrough: the prototypes and the website; below desktop a page with the header section draws it in its navbar form and puts its blocks in the page's reader (layout page, option reader). Pages without the header section draw the same in both.

noRule.screen: a page has no CSS: the context chooses how it composes its modules
noRule.walkthrough: a page has no CSS: the context chooses how it composes its modules

data.description: data.mjs: each state's route and form section (15-auth-states); the spread: system/content/auth-spread.mjs. Real copy: a page is not stress-tested.

states.hover: n/a: a page; its controls carry their own
states.focus-visible: n/a: a page; its controls carry their own
states.active: n/a: a page; its controls carry their own
states.disabled: n/a: a page; its controls carry their own
states.selected: n/a: a page; its controls carry their own
states.loading: yes: the sending state (a copy line over the form)
states.error: yes: the error and invalid states (a notice or help lines)
states.empty: n/a: a form, not a list

a11y.role: none of its own: the masthead (header) and the spread (main) with its two named sections
a11y.keyboard: the form in order: fields, the show/hide toggles, the forgot link, the submit, then the links
a11y.labels: each field by its label element; each section by its heading

responsive.note: no platform rule: the auth sections respond to their container
